question: Can verified prior evidence route a fixed measurement budget toward channels that make an already-unfolding state externally resolvable sooner than fixed headline monitoring and equal-budget wide monitoring?
claim_boundary: Synthetic observability-routing mechanism audit only. This is not a prediction, safety, causal-generalization, or runtime-authority claim.

candidate_router.frozen_rule: Force mandatory sentinel. Score remaining channels by receipt-tag match, fallback priority, first-look bonus, repeated-clean penalty, prior-positive bonus, and latency penalty; fill the fixed budget using deterministic tie-breaks.

baselines: fixed_headline: mandatory sentinel plus headline every tick
equal_budget_wide: mandatory sentinel plus deterministic round-robin non-sentinel coverage
resolution_rule: t_resolved is determined only by the frozen ExternalOracle from evidence actually measured by time t. Measurement policies cannot emit RESOLVED or runtime permission.
promotion_rule: SYNTHETIC_ROUTING_ADVANTAGE requires positive median held-out delta_tau against both baselines, identical per-tick telemetry budget, mandatory sentinel coverage, and no more false-resolution events than either baseline.
heldout_design: Held-out mechanisms include useful receipt routing, wrong prior, no precursor, unmonitored precursor, and nuisance-positive cases. Router does not receive partition or mechanism identity.
anti_rescue_rule: After the frozen replay report is produced, no score-weight, tie-break, budget, scenario, oracle, or baseline change may be used to rescue DOR-001. Any materially different router is DOR-002 or later.
